title: Patch Notes 1.23.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.23.0

Raiders!

Patch 1.23.0 is deploying now. Restart your game to install it. The Vanguard Set is now available in the shop, and the fixes included in this update are listed below.

## **ARC:**

* Corrected a bug that made Rocketeers play the wrong combat alert sound.

## **Gameplay:**

* Resolved a problem where two Trigger 'Nades could sometimes inflict triple damage if they went off next to each other.

* Fixed a bug that delayed item usage when a player held down fire while switching to another item.

* Fixed weapons and items firing on their own without player input.

* Corrected a shoulder swap glitch that locked the camera to only one side.

* Closed an exploit that let players use an anvil splitter without suffering the usual dispersion penalty.

* Barricades can no longer be set up on Ziplines.

## **Maps:**

* Fixed a bug that allowed players to catch fire while standing outside the locked room in Medical Research on Stella Montis.

* Fixed a location on Stella Montis where players could be shot through the floor.

* Fixed missing staircases in certain spots in Buried City.

* Fixed several cases where the code printer couldn't be interacted with during the Locked Gate encounter.

## **Close Scrutiny:**

* Adjusted the idle movement speed of Rocketeers and Vaporizers to stop them from behaving oddly while at rest.

* Fixed a bug where players who reconnected would see Assessor platforms rendered incorrectly.

* Fixed an issue causing Vaporizers to get stuck when approaching an Assessor.

* Fixed a problem that could stop an Assessor from returning to orbit. Also fixed an issue where spamming the Breach & Search prompts could break the breach platforms on an Assessor, which also prevented it from returning to orbit.

* ARC units summoned by an Assessor now properly leave the area and despawn after staying idle for an extended period.

* Pinging an Assessor on the map screen now shows its correct, actual position.

* Fixed a bug that could trap players when jumping between platforms on an Assessor.

* Fixed a location in Buried City where an Assessor and a Probe could both land on the same spot.

## **Other:**

* Fixed a bug that displayed the wrong upgrade tiers in the weapon upgrade UI.

* Fixed an issue causing helmet visors to appear fully transparent.

* Fixed several visual effects that were causing crashes. Investigation into all remaining crash causes is ongoing.

See you topside,

Ossen
